title: Journalism-Guided Agentic In-Context Learning for News Stance Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of an agentic in-context learning framework and the creation of a news stance detection dataset (K-NEWS-STANCE). While the target articles cover societal issues that may have ethical implications, the study aims to benchmark the model's ability to detect stances and media bias rather than evaluating the model's own moral, ethical, or religious frameworks.
